title: Assign asset to custodian — happy path
objective: Verify POST /assets/:uuid/assign assigns an assignable asset to a custodian, records lifecycle + audit events atomically, and returns updated asset state.
preconditions: Stack seeded; operator session; an asset in status 'Available' (or equivalent assignable status) with no active assignment.
test_data: asset A1 (available); custodian = seeded employee user; expected_return_at = future date
steps: POST /api/v1/assets/<A1>/assign with {custodian uuid, expected_return_at, notes} and CSRF + Idempotency-Key headers.
Inspect response status/body.
GET /api/v1/assets/<A1> and verify custodian/status fields.
GET /api/v1/assets/<A1>/history and verify assignment LifecycleEvent with actor, timestamp, summary.
expected_result: 201/200 response with updated asset (custodian set, status per transition rules, e.g. 'Assigned'); exactly one active Assignment row (returned_at null); LifecycleEvent + AuditEvent created atomically in the same request; response echoes correlation ID.

title: Reassignment atomically closes prior active assignment
objective: Verify assigning an already-assigned asset closes the prior active assignment (returned_at set, close_reason) and opens the new one in one transaction — never two active assignments.
preconditions: Asset A2 with an active assignment to custodian C1.
steps: POST /assets/<A2>/assign with custodian C2.
Query assignments for A2 (via API history or DB in pytest).
Verify prior assignment closed and new one active.
expected_result: Prior assignment has returned_at set + close_reason recorded; new assignment active; DB partial unique constraint holds (exactly one returned_at IS NULL row); both transitions audited; on any mid-failure (simulated in pytest) neither change persists (atomicity).

title: Assign rejected for non-assignable asset states
objective: Verify assign is rejected with a stable error code when the asset is in a non-assignable status (e.g., Under Maintenance, In Transit, Retired/Disposed) or fails assignability validation.
preconditions: Assets in each non-assignable status (seed or mutate via API).
test_data: asset under maintenance; asset in transit; disposed asset if reachable
steps: POST /assets/<uuid>/assign for each non-assignable asset.
Record status codes and error envelopes.
expected_result: Each returns 409 (ASSET_STATUS_TRANSITION_INVALID or ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT) with user-safe message and correlation_id; no assignment rows created; no lifecycle/audit mutation events beyond the rejected-attempt record if documented.

title: Assignment authorization — role and scope enforced
objective: Verify only Operator+ roles within scope can assign; employee/auditor get 403; out-of-scope operator gets 404 (no existence leak).
preconditions: Seeded users: employee, auditor, operator (scoped dept A), second operator scoped to dept B only; asset in dept B.
steps: POST assign as employee → record status.
POST assign as auditor → record status.
POST assign as operator scoped only to dept A against asset B1 → record status.
POST assign as operator scoped to dept B → success control.
expected_result: employee/auditor → 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; out-of-scope operator → 404 NOT_FOUND (identical to nonexistent asset response); in-scope operator succeeds; denials leak no asset data.

title: Custodian receipt acknowledgement
objective: Verify the assigned custodian can acknowledge receipt (acknowledged_at set) and acknowledgement is recorded in lifecycle/audit; other users cannot acknowledge on their behalf.
preconditions: Asset assigned to employee E (active assignment, acknowledged_at null).
test_data: employee E session; another employee session
steps: As employee E, call the acknowledgement endpoint (per API contract; record actual route from OpenAPI).
Verify assignment.acknowledged_at set.
As a different employee, attempt to acknowledge the same assignment.
expected_result: Custodian acknowledgement succeeds and is timestamped + audited; non-custodian attempt → 403/404; re-acknowledgement is idempotent or returns a stable 409.

title: Transfer asset between locations — full flow (J-2)
objective: Verify transfer creation with origin/destination/reason, In Transit state, recipient confirmation, and intact history across the transfer.
preconditions: Operator session; asset at location L1; destination location L2 seeded.
test_data: asset T1 at L1; transfer {to_location L2, reason 'Office move'}; Idempotency-Key
steps: POST /assets/<T1>/transfer with destination + reason.
Verify asset status becomes In Transit and TransferRecord created (pending/in_transit).
Attempt a second transfer or assignment while In Transit → expect rejection.
Confirm receipt as authorized recipient (confirm endpoint per OpenAPI).
Verify asset location = L2, status back to an assignable state, full history shows transfer events.
expected_result: Transfer lifecycle states transition per rules; conflicting operations during In Transit → 409; confirmation sets location/custodian per payload and records confirmed_by/at; history endpoint shows ordered transfer events with actors; audit events for each transition.

title: Transfer validation — missing destination/reason and invalid destination
objective: Verify boundary validation on transfer payload: required destination, reason per transition rules, rejection of inactive/nonexistent destination locations.
test_data: (a) no destination; (b) random UUID destination; (c) deactivated location UUID
steps: POST /transfer with each invalid payload.
Record error envelopes.
expected_result: (a) 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with field_errors on destination; (b)/(c) 400 or 404 without existence leak; no TransferRecord created; asset unchanged (version unchanged).

title: Transfer authorization and scope
objective: Verify transfer requires Operator+ role and scope over the asset's current location/department; employee/auditor denied; cross-scope denied with 404.
test_data: asset B1 in dept B; operator A, operator B, employee, auditor
steps: Attempt transfer as each user against asset B1.
expected_result: Only in-scope Operator+ succeeds; vertical escalation → 403; horizontal/scope violation → 404; no data leaked in error bodies.

title: Return/check-in closes assignment and applies condition
objective: Verify POST /assets/:uuid/return records condition, optional damage notes, destination, closes the active assignment, and sets resulting status per business rules.
preconditions: Asset R1 with active assignment to custodian; operator session.
test_data: return payload {condition 'Good', destination location, notes}; second payload {condition 'Damaged', damage description}
steps: POST /assets/<R1>/return with good condition.
Verify assignment closed (returned_at set), asset status per rules (e.g., Available), condition updated.
Assign and return a second asset with damaged condition; verify resulting status/flag per rules.
Verify lifecycle + audit events for both returns.
expected_result: Active assignment closed atomically; condition + resulting status match transition rules; damaged return creates the documented damage record/flag; history shows return events; no active assignment remains.

title: Return rejected when no active assignment
objective: Verify returning an asset with no active assignment fails with a stable error and no state change.
steps: POST /assets/<uuid>/return.
Record response; re-GET asset.
expected_result: 409 ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT (or documented code) with user-safe message; asset unchanged; no lifecycle/audit mutation events recorded for the rejected attempt.

title: Reservation create and overlap conflict prevention
objective: Verify reservation creation for an asset over a period, and that overlapping active reservations are rejected (exclusion constraint or service check).
test_data: reservation P1: day 1–5; overlapping P2: day 3–7; adjacent P3: day 5–8 (boundary per documented semantics)
steps: Create reservation P1 → success.
Create overlapping P2 → expect conflict.
Create adjacent P3 → verify documented boundary behavior (allowed or rejected consistently).
Verify reservation lifecycle events recorded.
expected_result: P1 confirmed; P2 → 409 with conflict error listing the overlapping reservation (no sensitive data beyond permitted scope); boundary behavior consistent and documented; concurrent double-booking attempt (pytest threads or sequential replay) cannot create two overlapping active reservations.

title: Checkout/return of reservation and overdue identification
objective: Verify reservation status lifecycle requested→confirmed→checked_out→returned (or cancelled/expired) and that overdue reservations are identifiable (filter/flag).
preconditions: Confirmed reservation for asset; operator session.
test_data: reservation with end date in the past (seed or created with short window)
steps: Check out the reserved asset; verify status + asset state.
Return it; verify reservation returned and asset available.
Create/seed an overdue reservation; query the overdue identification surface (filter or dashboard flag).
expected_result: State transitions per rules with audit trail; invalid transitions (e.g., return before checkout) → 409; overdue reservation appears in overdue identification with correct overdue duration.

title: Report asset lost/stolen/missing/damaged with evidence
objective: Verify POST /assets/:uuid/report-exception records the exception type, narrative, and evidence; updates asset status per rules; and creates lifecycle/audit events.
preconditions: Operator and employee sessions; assigned asset (employee is custodian) and unassigned asset.
test_data: exception types: lost, stolen, missing, damaged; evidence note (+ attachment if attachments delivered)
steps: As custodian employee, report assigned asset damaged with description.
As operator, report another asset lost with evidence.
Verify asset status/flag per transition rules for each type.
Verify history shows the exception events with reporter + timestamp.
expected_result: Each exception recorded with type, reporter, timestamp, evidence reference; status transitions follow rules (e.g., lost→'Lost'); employee can report only own custody assets (else 403/404); events appear in activity feed/history.

title: Exception resolution preserves original event (no erasure)
objective: Verify resolving an exception (e.g., lost asset recovered) appends a resolution event and never edits/deletes the original exception record.
steps: Resolve the exception via the documented endpoint.
Query history/activity for the asset.
Attempt to delete or edit the original exception event (API surface).
expected_result: Resolution appends new lifecycle + audit events; original exception event unchanged (before/after preserved); no API allows edit/delete of the original event (405/404); asset status updated per rules after resolution.

title: E2E Journey J-1 complete — register and assign a laptop
objective: Extend the Cycle-1 J-1 slice: after registering a laptop via UI, assign it to a custodian through the workflow UI and verify ack/history visibility.
preconditions: Full stack seeded; Playwright; operator and employee credentials.
test_data: new laptop asset; custodian = seeded employee
steps: Register new laptop via /assets/new (unique serial).
Open /assets/<id>/assign; select custodian; set expected return; submit.
Verify detail page shows custodian, Assigned badge (icon+text), and success feedback only after confirmed backend response.
Sign in as the custodian; verify asset appears in their 'my assets' scope; acknowledge if UI supports.
Open /assets/<id>/history and verify registration + assignment events visible with actors.
expected_result: Full journey completes without console errors; no optimistic success before backend confirmation; scoped visibility correct for custodian; history shows both events; screenshots captured as evidence.

title: E2E Journey J-2 — transfer asset to another office
objective: UI journey for transfer: initiate, observe In Transit state, confirm receipt, verify history and list filters update.
preconditions: Full stack seeded; Playwright; operator credentials; asset at seeded location L1.
steps: Open asset detail → transfer action; fill destination + reason; submit.
Verify asset shows In Transit badge (icon+text) and transfer actions disabled appropriately.
Confirm receipt via UI.
Verify location updated, badge cleared, history shows transfer chain.
Filter asset register by destination location and verify asset listed.
expected_result: Each UI state matches backend truth (no optimistic completion); badges use icon+text not color alone; filtered list consistent with new location; evidence captured.
